import { Component } from '@angular/core'; import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from '@/ui/avatar/avatar'; import { Button } from '@/ui/button/button'; import { Empty, EmptyContent, EmptyDescription, EmptyHeader, EmptyMedia, EmptyTitle, } from '@/ui/empty/empty'; /** An empty state with an avatar as its media, in the default style. */ @Component({ selector: 'example-empty-avatar', imports: [ Avatar, AvatarFallback, Button, Empty, EmptyContent, EmptyDescription, EmptyHeader, EmptyMedia, EmptyTitle, ], template: `
LR

Lena is away

She'll reply to messages when she's back on Monday.

`, }) export class EmptyAvatarExample {}
